newsitem.title: UK: Refuge has 95 pct of United Friendly shares.
newsitem.headline: Refuge has 95 pct of United Friendly shares.

text.p: Life insurer Refuge Group Plc said on Wednesday that it owned 95.18 percent of ordinary shares in United Friendly and declared its offer for the latter wholly unconditional.
Refuge also has 87.93 percent of B shares, which carry restricted voting rights.
Refuge shareholders earlier approved the 1.46 billion stg merger with United Friendly.
The new entity will be called United Assurance Group, which will be chaired by John Cudworth, who is currently Refuge's chief executive.
George Mack, finance director of United Friendly, will become chief executive of United Assurance.
